_comment: Explicit, editable referral rules. Mirrored in mobile/assets/config/referral_categories.json for offline on-device keyword flagging — keep both copies in sync (a shared config endpoint is a next step, not built for this demo).

categories.label: Repeat / recurring dispute
categories.reason: This looks like a repeat of a dispute between the same parties. Mediation may not be resolving the underlying issue.
categories.suggestedNextStep: Check prior case records for these parties and consider escalating to a formal forum if this is the second or third mediation attempt.

categories.label: Escalating conflict or violence
categories.reason: The description mentions threats, violence, or physical harm, which is outside the scope of informal mediation.
categories.suggestedNextStep: Refer to the local chief's office or police (Kenya) / relevant law enforcement (Nigeria) before any further mediation session.

categories.label: Formal land title / ownership dispute
categories.reason: This involves a registered land title or formal ownership dispute, which typically requires the land registry or courts, not informal mediation.
categories.suggestedNextStep: Refer to the Ministry of Lands / Land Registrar (Kenya) or the Land Use Act allocation authority (Nigeria) for title verification.

categories.label: Child protection concern
categories.reason: The description raises a possible child welfare or protection concern, which is outside mediation's normal scope.
categories.suggestedNextStep: Refer to the Children's Officer (Kenya) or the relevant social welfare office (Nigeria) rather than continuing informal mediation.

categories.label: Possible criminal matter
categories.reason: This description contains language suggesting a criminal offense (theft, fraud, sexual violence), which should go through police / formal justice, not mediation alone.
categories.suggestedNextStep: Advise the parties to also report to the nearest police station; mediation can continue on the civil aspects only if appropriate.
